verdict.rationale: Kong AI Gateway calculates per-request LLM cost matching actual provider billing (docs-18) and explicitly ties this to 'per-consumer spend limits, budget enforcement, and chargeback' (docs-33), while also stating it can 'track costs across teams' (docs-5/21). Logs and OTel metrics capture token usage, model details, and cost metrics (docs-10, docs-9) and can be aggregated centrally via Konnect or any OTel tool (docs-34), giving a single place to view spend across providers/models/consumers. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a unified per-key/per-user cost dashboard UI and independent/hands-on confirmation of the aggregated cost view working as described.
